query: INSERT INTO provider_presets (slug, name, base_url, adapter, config, politeness) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url, adapter = EXCLUDED.adapter, config = EXCLUDED.config, politeness = EXCLUDED.politeness, updated_at = now()
